verse.verse_1: Woe to every slanderer and backbiter.
verse.verse_2: Who has gathered wealth and counted it,
verse.verse_3: He thinks that his wealth will make him last forever!
verse.verse_4: Nay! Verily, he will be thrown into the crushing Fire.
verse.verse_5: And what will make you know what the crushing Fire is?
verse.verse_7: Which leaps up over the hearts,
verse.verse_8: Verily, it shall be closed in on them,
verse.verse_9: In pillars stretched forth (i.e. they will be punished in the Fire with pillars, etc.).
